title: Data Store Read
text: Read data from data store, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets Sample time; {Data store name} sets the name of data store from which block reads, {Data store memory block} sets the data Store Memory block name Read-only: block, {Corresponding Data Store Write blocks} sets the list of corresponding Data Store Write blocks Read-only: block, {Elements in the array (Signals in the bus)} sets the elements in associated data store character, {Specify element(s) to select} sets the mATLAB expression that defines element to select character, {Selected element(s)} sets the list of selected elements, {Enable indexing}, {Number of dimensions}, {Index mode}, {Index Option} sets the index method for subelements, {Index} sets the indices or starting index of subelements and {Output Size} sets the size of range of subelements to read. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: IdxN
ports.summary: N th index signal scalar | vector

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Values from specified data store scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.values: List of corresponding Data Store Write blocks Read-only: block path

params.values: Elements in associated data store character vector

params.values: Index method for subelements Index vector (dialog) (default) | Select all | Index vector (port) | Starting index (dialog) | Starting index (port)

params.values: Size of range of subelements to read 1 (default) | integer
